[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-ay[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Bare `@` opens one reference menu for artifact kinds and local [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]files[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Typing `@` in the ACE prompt input or in an LSP-backed editor [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]immediately opens a single reference menu whose artifact-kind rows [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and local file-path rows are visibly grouped, with menu policy [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]shared by Rust core so both frontends agree, and with no filesystem[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]work on the keystroke path.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Shared `@` reference menu core[/bold #D7AFFF]                                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]core[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core: add the `sase_core::editor::at_reference` module — cursor context [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]detection that accepts a bare `@` and path-shaped tokens, plus a pure [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]I/O-free grouped menu builder whose inventory is supplied by the caller.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]PyO3 bindings for the reference menu[/bold #D7AFFF]                          [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]binding[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]binding: export `at_reference_context` and `at_reference_menu` from [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`sase_core_py` as JSON-dict functions in the style of [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`placeholder_completion`, with binding-level tests.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Editor LSP reference completion[/bold #D7AFFF]                               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]lsp[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]lsp: route `sase lsp` artifact completion through the shared module, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]enumerate local path inventory from the client root, and shape items so [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]any client filters and orders the two groups correctly.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Completion panel row budget[/bold #D7AFFF]                                   [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]panel_rows[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]panel_rows: derive the visible-row budget from the panel's real content [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]capacity so the highlighted row and the overflow indicator are never [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]clipped, and reserve a line for a group rule when one is rendered.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Warm local path inventory for the prompt[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]

    [#D7D7AF]background loader, a loading row, and warm-on-focus, so prompt path rows[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]never touch disk from a keystroke.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
